thread:
Lina (CS): Heads-up: BlueOcean Labs wants a short-term throughput bump ahead of a product webinar tomorrow at 09:30 UTC. They requested a region pin to eu-west-1 + ap-northeast-1, peering allowlist for two CIDRs, and a temporary RLift for 72h. Also flagged renewal sensitivity — campaign could push them to enterprise tier.

Marco (Support): Got it. Can you paste org id and CIDRs? Also need to confirm whether traffic comes through our peering or public endpoints.

Lina (CS): Org: org_BOx1. CIDRs: 45.33.21.0/24, 203.119.18.64/26. They said AWS DX peering.

Priya (NetEng): We can add peering ACL entries and set region pinning. Quick question: they want TLS client cert validation on ingress or just IP allowlist? If certs, we'll need cert thumbprints and CA.

Lina (CS): For now IP allowlist only. They may ask for mTLS later.

Jon (AM): I'll reach out to SalesOps to start renewal convo. If their monthly run-rate doubles for the campaign we should offer a short-term commitment or tier credit.

Marco (Support): Ticket created: #CS-4609. Ops CLI snippet to apply (staged change):

```
/rlift allowlist create --org org_BOx1 --cidr 45.33.21.0/24 --cidr 203.119.18.64/26 --regions eu-west-1,ap-northeast-1 --throughput-multiplier 2.5 --duration 72h --autorevoke
```

Marco (Support): Adding note: customer wants preserved headers: x-bo-trace, x-client-region. Also asked for pre-warm of KV cache if possible.

Priya (NetEng): Added ACLs on peering side. We'll mark route as pinned to preferred regions. Pre-warm: can kick a warmup job to populate cache; need access key from customer to simulate.

Lina (CS): Customer can run a warmup lambda, but asked if we can trigger a small synthetic warmup from our side. Do we have an internal warmup job?

Priya (NetEng): We have a queued warmup script but it needs product signoff since it incurs small token cost. infra-bot: please start change window approval.

infra-bot: Change queued: #CS-4609 -> window 08:00-08:20 UTC. Approve with :thumbsup:.

Jon (AM): Approved. :thumbsup:.

Marco (Support): Deployed allowlist entries and region pinning. Verified inbound from 45.33.21.27 and 203.119.18.70. Initiated warmup job (1000 sample prompts) after AM approval. Monitoring metrics now.

Lina (CS): Customer confirmed lower p50 latency from tokyo and ireland in their tests. They also suggested a Console feature: "temporary burst toggle" with a simple slider + auto-revoke — filing as product FR.

Jon (AM): Noted for renewal discussion. Captured expected uplift and proposed commitment options.

Priya (NetEng): Leaving monitoring for 48h. Auto-revoke set at 72h unless CS extends via ticket. I'll drop a note when revoke happens.

Marco (Support): Closing loop: emailed customer with ticket link and live confirmation.

Lina (CS): Thanks team — tracking action items: sales reachout, product FR, and confirm auto-revoke at 72h.
